  FORM fill_activation_options
     using    proto_handle     type scpr_handl
              control_user     like sy-uname
              act_date         like sy-datum
              act_time         like sy-uzeit
              act_system       like sy-sysid
              act_client       like sy-mandt

              safety           type char1

              upgrade_mode     type char1
              variables_off    type char1
              after_imp        type char1
              langu_only       type char1
              category         type scpr_ctgry
              no_commit        type sap_bool
     changing actopts          type scpractopt.

    clear: actopts.
* act_id: id of activation process (guid)
    actopts-act_id = proto_handle.
* act_user: username
    actopts-act_user = control_user.
* act_date: date of activation
    actopts-act_date = act_date.
* act_time: time of activation
    actopts-act_time = act_time.
* act_system: system id of activation system
    actopts-act_system = act_system.
* act_client: client id of activation client
    actopts-act_client = act_client.
* contr_syst: system id of system where the activation was startet from
    actopts-contr_syst = control_system.
* rc_activ: status of activation process
    actopts-rc_activ = rc_activ.
* dialog: Y=dialog, N=background (default)
    if activation_type = 0.
      actopts-dialog = answer_yes.
    else.
      actopts-dialog = answer_no.

    else.

    endif.

    if no_standard is initial.
      actopts-no_standrd = act_all.
    else.
      actopts-no_standrd = no_standard.
    endif.
* transp_off: Y=write all data and transport no data at all,
*             N=data activation and transport due to system and client
*               settings (default)
    actopts-transp_off = transport_off.
* sysedt_off: Y=ignore productive system/client check
*             N=consider productive system/client check (default)
    actopts-sysedt_off = sysedit_off.
* safety: Y=activate data only if bcsets and objects do not show errors
*         N=activate as much data as possible (default)
    actopts-safety = safety.
* call_from: flag describing the caller (see SCPREXTCONST)
    if call_from is initial.
      actopts-call_from = cf_unknown.
    else.
      actopts-call_from = call_from.
    endif.
* upgr_mode: Y=system is in upgrade mode
*            N=system is not in upgrade mode (default)
    if upgrade_mode is initial.
      actopts-upgr_mode = answer_no.
    else.
      actopts-upgr_mode = answer_yes.
    endif.

* sys_status: 0=system transport active
*             1=system transport deactivated (default)
    if actopts-transp_off = answer_yes.

    else.
      actopts-cus_status = '0'.
      actopts-sys_status = '0'.

*             N=variables are used (default)
    actopts-varbls_off = variables_off.
* after_imp: Y=after-import-methods are performed (default)
*            N=after-import-methods are ignored
    actopts-after_imp = after_imp.
* langu_only: Y=activate only languages
*             N=activate all data
    actopts-langu_only = langu_only.
* category: ' ' = classical BC-Sets
*           'S' = Switch BC-Sets
    actopts-category = category.

    actopts-no_commit = no_commit.
  ENDFORM.                    " fill_activation_options

         using     p_bcset           type scpr_id
                   p_activity        type scprreca-activity
                   p_objectname      type scprreca-objectname
                   p_objecttype      type scprreca-objecttype
         changing  recattr           type scpr_reca_tab
                   values            type scpr_vals_tab
                   valuesl           type scpr_vall_tab
                   act_objects       type SCP1_ACT_OBJECTS
                   objvalues         type scpr_objvals
                   bcsets_attrs      type scpr_attr_tab.
* this form removes all data of a certain customizing object
* (objectname, objecttype) from all relevant activation tables
* (recattr, values, valuesl, act_objects, objvalues, bcsets_attrs).
* following calls are possible (using parameters):
*
* loop at recattr may be slower than binary search but is used her
* by intention to be independent on sort order of recattr!!!
*
* values must be sorted by id version tablename recnumber
* valuesl must be sorted by id version tablename recnumber
*
* p_bcset   |p_activity| p_objectname/-type | result: remove...
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
*  initial  | initial  | objectname + -type | object from all bcsets
*  initial  | activity | objectname + -type | object/act from all bcsets
* BC-Set ID | initial  | objectname + -type | object from given bcset
* BC-Set ID | activity | objectname + -type | object/activity from bcset

    data act_objects_temp  type scp1_act_objects.

    field-symbols <act_object>  type scp1_act_object.
    field-symbols <wa_recattr>  type scprreca.
    field-symbols <wa_value>    type scprvals.
    field-symbols <wa_valuel>   type scprvall.


* update recattr, values and valuesl
    loop at recattr assigning <wa_recattr>
        where objectname = p_objectname and objecttype = p_objecttype.
* check bcset
      if not p_bcset is initial and <wa_recattr>-id <> p_bcset.
        continue.
      endif.
* check activity
      if not p_activity is initial
                              and <wa_recattr>-activity <> p_activity.
        continue.
      endif.
* delete values
      read table values with key
                      id = <wa_recattr>-id
                      tablename = <wa_recattr>-tablename
                      recnumber = <wa_recattr>-recnumber
                      binary search transporting no fields.
      if sy-subrc = 0.
        loop at values assigning <wa_value> from sy-tabix.
          if <wa_value>-id <> <wa_recattr>-id
               or <wa_value>-tablename <> <wa_recattr>-tablename
               or <wa_value>-recnumber <> <wa_recattr>-recnumber.
            exit.
          endif.
          delete values.
        endloop.
      endif.
* delete valuesl
      read table valuesl with key
                      id = <wa_recattr>-id
                      tablename = <wa_recattr>-tablename
                      recnumber = <wa_recattr>-recnumber
                      binary search transporting no fields.
      if sy-subrc = 0.
        loop at valuesl assigning <wa_valuel> from sy-tabix.
          if <wa_valuel>-id <> <wa_recattr>-id
              or <wa_valuel>-tablename <> <wa_recattr>-tablename
              or <wa_valuel>-recnumber <> <wa_recattr>-recnumber.
            exit.
          endif.
          delete valuesl.
        endloop.
      endif.
      delete recattr.
    endloop.


* update act_objects
    refresh act_objects_temp.
    loop at act_objects assigning <act_object>
       where objectname = p_objectname and objecttype = p_objecttype.
* check bcset
      if not p_bcset is initial and <act_object>-bcset <> p_bcset.
        continue.
      endif.
* check activity
      if not p_activity is initial
                              and <act_object>-activity <> p_activity.
        continue.
      endif.
      append <act_object> to act_objects_temp.
      delete act_objects.
    endloop.


* update objvalues
    read table recattr with key objectname = p_objectname
                      objecttype = p_objecttype transporting no fields.
    if sy-subrc <> 0.
      delete objvalues where objectname = p_objectname
                       and   objecttype = p_objecttype.
    endif.


* upddate bcsets_attrs
    sort act_objects_temp by bcset.
    delete adjacent duplicates from act_objects_temp comparing bcset.
    loop at act_objects_temp assigning <act_object>.
      read table recattr with key id = <act_object>-bcset
                                                transporting no fields.
      if sy-subrc <> 0.
        delete bcsets_attrs where id = <act_object>-bcset.
      endif.
    endloop.

  ENDFORM.                    " Remove_OBJECT_FROM_DATA

    changing index     type i.
* this form searches a data record 'record' in a table 's_table'

* this form determines the 'langu_rec_types' of text table data records
* corresponding to generical primary table records of S-objects:
* 1 = generical key field is before the language key field
* 2 = generical key field = language key field
* 3 = generical key field is after the language key field

    data genkeyfield_T  type scpr_fld.
    data langufield_T   type scpr_fld.

    field-symbols <fielddescr>    type scpr_descr.
    field-symbols <fielddescr_T>  type scpr_descr.


    clear: error, langu_rec_type, genkeyfield_T, langufield_T.
    read table fielddescrs assigning <fielddescr>
                                     with key fieldname = genkeyfield.
    if sy-subrc = 0 and <fielddescr> is assigned.
      genkeyfield_T = <fielddescr>-txttabfldn.
    else.
      error = 'X'.
      exit.
    endif.
    read table fielddescrs_T assigning
                            <fielddescr_T> with key datatype = 'LANG'.
    if sy-subrc = 0 and <fielddescr_T> is assigned.
      langufield_T = <fielddescr_T>-fieldname.
    else.
      error = 'X'.
      exit.
    endif.
    if genkeyfield_T = langufield_T.
      langu_rec_type = 2.
      exit.
    endif.
    loop at fielddescrs_T assigning <fielddescr_T> where keyflag = 'X'.
      if <fielddescr_T>-fieldname = langufield_T.
        langu_rec_type = 3.
        exit.
      elseif <fielddescr_T>-fieldname = genkeyfield_T.
        langu_rec_type = 1.
        exit.
      endif.
    endloop.


  ENDFORM.                    " get_langu_rec_type

*&      Form  get_view_ddic
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*  -->  p1        text

  FORM get_view_ddic
    using    tabledescr  type scpr_record2
             header      type vimdesc
    changing viewtables  type scpr_dd26v_tab
             viewfields  type scpr_dd27p_tab
             viewjoins   TYPE scpr_dd28j_tab.

    data fielddescr   type SCPR_DESCR.
    data viewfield    type dd27p.
    data viewjoin     type dd28j.
    data viewtable    type dd26v.

    refresh: viewtables, viewfields, viewjoins.
* get ddic infos of view/view variante
    if not tabledescr-tabname is initial.
      if tabledescr-tabname = header-maintview.
* at views just get infos from DDIC
        CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_VIEW_GET'
          EXPORTING
            NAME          = tabledescr-tabname
            STATE         = 'A'
            LANGU         = ' '
          TABLES
            DD26V_TAB     = viewtables
            DD27P_TAB     = viewfields
            DD28J_TAB     = viewjoins
          EXCEPTIONS
            ILLEGAL_INPUT = 1
            OTHERS        = 2.
        if sy-subrc <> 0.
          refresh: viewtables, viewfields, viewjoins.
        endif.

      else.
* at view variants (header-maintview <> header-viewname)...
        if header-bastab is initial.
* at view variants based on a View (header-bastab is initial):
*    -> get ddic infos of maintenance view and adapt viewname
*       in tables viewtables, viewfields and viewjoins
          CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_VIEW_GET'
            EXPORTING
              NAME          = header-maintview
              STATE         = 'A'
              LANGU         = ' '
            TABLES
              DD26V_TAB     = viewtables
              DD27P_TAB     = viewfields
              DD28J_TAB     = viewjoins
            EXCEPTIONS
              ILLEGAL_INPUT = 1
              OTHERS        = 2.
          IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
* adapt viewtables
            loop at viewtables into viewtable
                                where viewname <> tabledescr-tabname.
              viewtable-viewname = tabledescr-tabname.
              modify viewtables from viewtable transporting viewname.
            endloop.
* adapt viewfields
            loop at viewfields into viewfield
                                 where viewname <> tabledescr-tabname.
              viewfield-viewname = tabledescr-tabname.
              modify viewfields from viewfield transporting viewname.
            endloop.
* adapt viewjoins
            loop at viewjoins into viewjoin
                                 where viewname <> tabledescr-tabname.
              viewjoin-viewname = tabledescr-tabname.
              modify viewjoins from viewjoin transporting viewname.
            endloop.
          else.
            refresh: viewtables, viewfields, viewjoins.
          ENDIF.
        else.
* at view variants based on a S-Table (header-bastab = 'X'):
*  -> viewtables, viewfields and viewjoins must be filled manually
* fill viewtables
          clear viewtable.
          viewtable-viewname = tabledescr-tabname.
          viewtable-tabname = header-maintview.
          viewtable-tabpos = '0001'.
          viewtable-fortabname = header-maintview.
          append viewtable to viewtables.
          if not header-texttbexst is initial.
            clear viewtable.
            viewtable-viewname = tabledescr-tabname.
            viewtable-tabname = header-texttab.
            viewtable-tabpos = '0002'.
            viewtable-fortabname = header-maintview.
            viewtable-fordir = 'I'.
            read table tabledescr-descr index 1 into fielddescr.
            if sy-subrc = 0.
              viewtable-forfield = fielddescr-txttabfldn.
            else.
              viewtable-forfield = 'X'.
            endif.
            append viewtable to viewtables.
          endif.
        endif.
* fill viewfields
        clear viewfield.
        viewfield-viewname = tabledescr-tabname.
        loop at tabledescr-descr into fielddescr.
          viewfield-objpos = sy-tabix.
          viewfield-viewfield = fielddescr-fieldname.
          viewfield-tabname = fielddescr-bastabname.
          viewfield-fieldname = fielddescr-bastabfld.
          viewfield-keyflag = fielddescr-keyflag.
          viewfield-rdonly = fielddescr-readonly.
          viewfield-domname = fielddescr-domname.
          viewfield-datatype = fielddescr-datatype.
          viewfield-intlen = fielddescr-intlen.
          viewfield-outputlen = fielddescr-outputlen.
          viewfield-decimals = fielddescr-decimals.
          viewfield-lowercase = fielddescr-lowercase.
          append viewfield to viewfields.
        endloop.
* fill viewjoins
        if not header-texttbexst is initial.
          clear viewjoin.
          viewjoin-viewname = tabledescr-tabname.
          viewjoin-ltab = header-maintview.
          viewjoin-operator = 'EQ'.
          viewjoin-rtab = header-texttab.
          viewjoin-source = 'F'.
          viewjoin-frktab = header-texttab.
          viewjoin-frkdir = 'I'.
          loop at tabledescr-descr into fielddescr
                                         where not keyflag is initial.
            viewjoin-lfield = fielddescr-fieldname.
            viewjoin-rfield = fielddescr-bastabfld.
            append viewjoin to viewjoins.
          endloop.
        endif.
      endif.
    endif.  "viewname initial

  ENDFORM.                    " get_view_ddic

  FORM check_cliindep_smls
    using    bcset           type scpr_id
             version         type scpr_vers
             moddate         type scpr_date
             modtime         type scpr_time
             tablename       type scpr_tabl
             recnumber       type scpr_recnr
             record          type any
             fielddescrs     type scpr_descs
             it_smli         type scpr_smli_tab
    changing key_protected   type char1.         "X=not activate record
* this form checks if a single key (not generical) of a client
* independent DB table is protected Via SMLs against overwriting by a
* bc-set activation
*
* parameter recnumber:
* at data records without generical reference  -> the recnumber of the
*                                              record must be provided
* at data records with a generical reference -> the recnumber of the
*                          (generical) refernce record must be provided

    data full_key_part  type scprskeys-tablekey.
    data gen_key_part   type scprskeys-tablekey.
    data gen_keylen     type i.
    data index_temp     type sytabix.
    data sml_key        type SCPRSKEYS-TABLEKEY.
    data wa_smli        type scprsmli.

    clear key_protected.
* check if any SML to the record is found
    read table it_smli with key bcset     = bcset
                                version   = version
                                moddate   = moddate
                                modtime   = modtime
                                tablename = tablename
                                recnumber = recnumber
                                binary search transporting no fields.
    if sy-subrc = 0.
      index_temp = sy-tabix.
* check if a 'Space'-SML to the record is found
      read table it_smli with key bcset     = bcset
                                  version   = version
                                  moddate   = moddate
                                  modtime   = modtime
                                  tablename = tablename
                                  recnumber = recnumber
                                  tablekey  = ' '
                                  binary search transporting no fields.
      if sy-subrc = 0.
        key_protected = 'X'.
      else.
* calculate SML key
        CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_SFW_GET_SMLKEY'
          EXPORTING
            RECORD      = record
            GEN_RECORD  = ' '
            FIELDDESCRS = fielddescrs
          IMPORTING
            SML_KEY     = sml_key.
        loop at it_smli into wa_smli from index_temp.
          if wa_smli-bcset <> bcset or wa_smli-version <> version
                                    or wa_smli-moddate <> moddate
                                    or wa_smli-modtime <> modtime
                                    or wa_smli-tablename <> tablename
                                    or wa_smli-recnumber <> recnumber.
            exit.
          endif.
          if wa_smli-generic_key is initial.
* at single record SMLs check if record key = protected key
            if wa_smli-tablekey = sml_key.
              key_protected = 'X'.
              exit.
            endif.
          else.
* at generical area SMLs check if record key (fully specified) is part
* of the generical range
            gen_keylen = strlen( wa_smli-tablekey ) - 2.
            if gen_keylen is initial.
              key_protected = 'X'.
              exit.
            else.
              gen_key_part = wa_smli-tablekey(gen_keylen).
              full_key_part = sml_key(gen_keylen).
              if gen_key_part = full_key_part.
                key_protected = 'X'.
                exit.
              endif.
            endif.
          endif.
        endloop.  "it_smli
      endif.
    endif.

  ENDFORM.                    " check_cliindep_smls

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  generical_deletions
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*  -->  p1        text
*  <--  p2        text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
  FORM generical_deletions
      using     client        type mandt
                bcset         type scprbccli
                act_part      type scp1_act_part
                part_table    type scp1_part_table
                tabledescr    type scpr_record2
                records       type any table
                rec_infos     type scp1_recinfos1_tab
                it_smld       type scpr_smld_tab
                it_smli       type scpr_smli_tab
                make_revertable type abap_bool
       changing del_count     type i
                del_error     type char1
                del_records   type standard table    "do not use outside
                bcsets_stati  type scprbcclitab.              .
* the form performs the generical deletions of switch bc-set activations

    data  record          type ref to data.
    data  record_temp     type ref to data.

    data key_allowed       type TRPARI-KEYALLOWED.
    data key_protected(1)  type c.
    data key120            type e071k-tabkey.
    data key255            type scpr_tabky.
    data last_char         type i.
    data msgvar1           type symsgv.
    data msgvar2           type symsgv.
    data msgvar3           type symsgv.
    data msgvar4           type symsgv.
    data where_clause      type string.
    data sml_protection(1) type c.
    data system_sap        type TRPARI-SYSTEM_SAP.

    data rec_error(1)      type c.        "error at single gen. record
    data rec_info          type scp1_recinfos1.

    data selectfields      type standard table of scpr_fld.
    data struct_ref        type ref to cl_abap_structdescr.

    field-symbols <fielddescr>    type scpr_descr.
    field-symbols <record>        type any.
    field-symbols <record_temp>   type any.
    field-symbols <value>         type any.
    field-symbols <value_temp>    type any.

* initialize
    create data record type (tabledescr-tabname).
    assign record->* to <record>.
    create data record_temp type (tabledescr-tabname).
    assign record_temp->* to <record_temp>.

* calculate key fields (for select)
    refresh selectfields.
* add check if we need to select (and store) revert data
    if make_revertable = abap_true.
      append '*' to selectfields.
    else.
      loop at tabledescr-descr assigning <fielddescr> where keyflag = 'X'.
        append <fielddescr>-fieldname to selectfields.
      endloop.
    endif.
* loop records
    loop at records assigning <record>.
      clear rec_error.
* get additional infos according to the record
      read table rec_infos index sy-tabix into rec_info.
      if sy-subrc <> 0 or rec_info-recnumber is initial
                       or rec_info-genkeyfield is initial.
        rec_error = 'X'.
      endif.

* check if the generical key area is fully protected by SMLs
      if rec_error is initial.
        if tabledescr-clnt_fld is initial.
          read table it_smli with key bcset     = bcset-bcset
                                      version   = bcset-version
                                      moddate   = bcset-moddate
                                      modtime   = bcset-modtime
                                      tablename = tabledescr-tabname
                                      recnumber = rec_info-recnumber
                                      tablekey  = ' '
                                 binary search transporting no fields.
        else.
          read table it_smld with key client    = client
                                      bcset     = bcset-bcset
                                      version   = bcset-version
                                      moddate   = bcset-moddate
                                      modtime   = bcset-modtime
                                      tablename = tabledescr-tabname
                                      recnumber = rec_info-recnumber
                                      tablekey  = ' '
                                 binary search transporting no fields.
        endif.
        if sy-subrc = 0.
* whole generical key area is protected by SMLs
*            -> no activation but an entry into the activation protocol
          if 1 = 2. message e741 with ' ' ' ' ' ' ' '. endif.
          msgvar1 = bcset-bcset.
          msgvar2 = client.
          msgvar3 = tabledescr-tabname.
          clear: msgvar4, key255.
          perform convert_record_to_ckey
            using <record> tabledescr-ckeylen tabledescr-clnt_fld
            changing key255.
          msgvar4 = key255.
          CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_ACTIV_HANDLE_ACTMESSAGE'
            EXPORTING
              STATUS        = err_info
              WRITE_MESSAGE = 'X'
              BCSET         = bcset-bcset
              CATEGORY      = bcset-category
              CLIENT        = client
              MSGID         = 'SCPR'
              MSGNO         = '741'
              VAR1          = msgvar1
              VAR2          = msgvar2
              VAR3          = msgvar3
              VAR4          = msgvar4
              OBJECTNAME    = act_part-objectname
              OBJECTTYPE    = act_part-objecttype
              TABLENAME     = tabledescr-tabname
              TABLETYPE     = otype_table
              TABLEKEY      = key255
            CHANGING
              ACT_BCSETS    = bcsets_stati.

        else.
* build generical where-clause (for select or delete). cases:
* cli-dep | key | GKF | example | where_clause
* -------------------------------------------------------------------
*    X    |  X  | pg  | 000AB*  | MANDT=000 and K=A and GKF like B%
*    X    |  X  | fg  | 000A*   | MANDT=000 and K=A
*    X    |  -  | pg  | 000B*   | MANDT=000 and GKF like B%
*    X    |  -  | fg  | 000*    | MANDT=000
*    -    |  X  | pg  | AB*     | K=A and GKF like B%
*    -    |  X  | fg  | A*      | K=A
*    -    |  -  | pg  | B*      | GKF like B%
*    -    |  -  | fg  | *       | initial
*
* key = one or more fully spezified key fields in front of the generical
*       key field
* GKF = generical key field
* pg  = partially generical field (i.e. 'B*'). this is only possible at
*       fields with vtype 'C'.
* fg  = fully generical key field = all fields with vtype <> 'C' and
*       all fields of vtype 'C' with value '*'
          clear: where_clause.
          loop at tabledescr-descr
                          assigning <fielddescr> where keyflag = 'X'.
* add client field
            if sy-tabix = 1 and <fielddescr>-datatype = 'CLNT'.
              concatenate where_clause 'AND' <fielddescr>-fieldname
                         '= ''' into where_clause separated by space.
              concatenate where_clause client '''' into where_clause.
              continue.
            endif.
* add non-client fields...
            assign component <fielddescr>-fieldname
                                    of structure <record> to <value>.
            if sy-subrc <> 0 or not <value> is assigned.
              rec_error = 'X'.
              exit.
            endif.
            if <fielddescr>-fieldname = rec_info-genkeyfield.
* add the generical key field
              if <fielddescr>-vtype = 'C'.
                clear last_char.
                last_char = strlen( <value> ) - 1.
                if last_char is initial.
                  exit.
                else.
                  find '*' in section offset last_char length 1
                                                          of <value>.
                  if sy-subrc = 0.
                    assign <value>(last_char) to <value_temp>.
                    concatenate where_clause 'AND'
                     <fielddescr>-fieldname 'LIKE ''' into
                       where_clause separated by space.
                    concatenate where_clause <value_temp> '%'''
                                                    into where_clause.
                    exit.
                  else.
                    rec_error = 'X'.
                    exit.
                  endif.
                endif.
              else.
                exit.
              endif.
            else.
* add a simple key field
              if <value> is initial.
                concatenate where_clause 'AND' <fielddescr>-fieldname
                     '= ''' '''' into where_clause separated by space.
              else.
                concatenate where_clause 'AND' <fielddescr>-fieldname
                          '= ''' into where_clause separated by space.
                concatenate where_clause <value> '''' into where_clause.
              endif.
            endif.
          endloop.  "where_clause
          if not where_clause is initial.
            shift where_clause by 5 places.
          endif.

* check if the generical key area is partially protected by SMLs
          if rec_error is initial.
            clear sml_protection.
            if tabledescr-clnt_fld is initial.
              read table it_smli with key bcset     = bcset-bcset
                                       version   = bcset-version
                                       moddate   = bcset-moddate
                                       modtime   = bcset-modtime
                                       tablename = tabledescr-tabname
                                       recnumber = rec_info-recnumber
                                 binary search transporting no fields.
            else.
              read table it_smld with key client    = client
                                       bcset     = bcset-bcset
                                       version   = bcset-version
                                       moddate   = bcset-moddate
                                       modtime   = bcset-modtime
                                       tablename = tabledescr-tabname
                                       recnumber = rec_info-recnumber
                                 binary search transporting no fields.
            endif.
            if sy-subrc = 0.
              sml_protection = 'X'.  "partial overlap with SMLs
            endif.
            if sml_protection is initial
                                     and rec_info-key_mixed is initial.
* deleted generical key area
* add check so that this is only done for revertable BCSets
              if make_revertable = abap_true.
                refresh del_records.
                select (selectfields) from (tabledescr-tabname)
                            client specified into table del_records
                            where (where_clause).
                CALL METHOD CL_SCPR_REVERT_HELPER=>DELETE_TABLE
                        EXPORTING
                          IV_BCSET      = bcset-bcset
                          iv_client     = client
                          IS_TABLEDESCR = tabledescr
                          IT_RECORDS    = del_records
                          IV_OBJECTNAME = act_part-OBJECTNAME
                          IV_OBJECTTYPE = act_part-OBJECTTYPE
                          IV_ACTIVITY   = act_part-ACTIVITY
                          iv_viewname   = part_table-TABNAME
                          .
              endif.
              delete from (tabledescr-tabname)
                                 client specified where (where_clause).
              del_count = del_count + sy-dbcnt.
            else.
* a part of the generical key area is protected by SMLs or customer name
* space  ->  read corresponing single records from DB
              refresh del_records.
              select (selectfields) from (tabledescr-tabname)
                            client specified into table del_records
                            where (where_clause).

* if necessary check single records according to TRESC (name space)
              if not rec_info-key_mixed is initial
                                        and not del_records is initial.
                loop at del_records assigning <record_temp>.
                  if sy-tabix = 1.
* statement has to be executed only once
                    struct_ref ?= cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( <record_temp> ).
                  endif.
                  clear key120.
                  CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_SV_RECORD_TO_TRANSPKEY'
                    EXPORTING
                      RECORD       = <record_temp>
                      CLIENT_FIELD = tabledescr-clnt_fld
                      KEYLEN       = tabledescr-keylen
                      CKEYLEN      = tabledescr-ckeylen
                      GENKEYLEN    = tabledescr-ckeylen "ok: single recs
                      TREAT_CLIENT = ' '
                      ip_struct_descr = struct_ref
                    importing
                      TRANSPKEY    = key120.
                  if key120 is initial.
                    delete del_records.  "should not happen: no deletion
                    continue.    "to next record
                  else.
                    clear: key_allowed, system_sap.
                    CALL FUNCTION 'CHECK_CUSTOMER_NAMES'
                      EXPORTING
                        OBJECTTYPE            = 'TABU'
                        TABLEKEY              = key120
                        TABLENAME             = tabledescr-tabname

            genkeyfield_V = fielddescr-fieldname.
          else.
            if not wa_vals-value is initial and fielddescr-vtype = 'C'.
              last_char = strlen( wa_vals-value ) - 1.
              find '*' in section offset last_char length 1
                                                     of wa_vals-value.
              if sy-subrc = 0.
                genkeyfield_V = fielddescr-fieldname.
              endif.
            endif.
          endif.
        endif.
      endloop.
* check if generical view field is in secondary table
      clear genkeyfield_S.
      read table viewfields into viewfield
                         with key viewname  = viewname
                                  viewfield = genkeyfield_V
                                  tabname   = sectabname.
      if sy-subrc = 0.
* check if this field is a key field (examples where this field was
* a data field have been found)
        read table fielddescrs_S
                      with key tablename = sectabname
                               fieldname = viewfield-fieldname
                               keyflag   = 'X' transporting no fields.
        if sy-subrc = 0.
          genkeyfield_S = viewfield-fieldname.
        endif.
      endif.
    else.
* ...genkeyfield is in primary table
*     -> get generical view field (genkeyfield_V) out of viewmappings
      read table viewmappings into viewmapping
                                 with key viewname  = viewname
                                          tablename = primtabname
                                          tablefield = genkeyfield_P.
      if sy-subrc = 0 and not viewmapping-viewfield is initial.
* ...get generical field of secondary table (genkeyfield_S)...
        genkeyfield_V = viewmapping-viewfield.
        read table viewmappings into viewmapping
                                  with key viewname  = viewname
                                           viewfield = genkeyfield_V
                                           tablename = sectabname.
        if sy-subrc = 0.
          genkeyfield_S = viewmapping-tablefield.
        else.
          clear genkeyfield_S.
        endif.
      else.
* generical view field not found -> should not happen
        return.  "rec_type_S is space
      endif.
    endif.  "genkeyfield_P initial

    if genkeyfield_S is initial.
* generical field is not in secondary table key -> single deletion
      if langu_field is initial.
        rec_type_S = 3.
      else.
        rec_type_S = 4.
      endif.
    else.
* generical field is in secondary table key -> generical deletion
      if langu_field is initial.
        rec_type_S = 5.
      else.
* ...get order of langu field and generical field
        if langu_field = genkeyfield_S.
          rec_type_S = 7.
        else.
          loop at fielddescrs_S into fielddescr where keyflag = 'X'.
            if fielddescr-fieldname = langu_field.
              rec_type_S = 8.
              exit.
            elseif fielddescr-fieldname = genkeyfield_S.
              rec_type_S = 6.
              exit.
            endif.
          endloop.
        endif.
      endif.
    endif.

  elseif deleteflag = status_delete.
* single deletion in view -> single deletion in secondary table
    if langu_field is initial.
      rec_type_S = 3.
    else.
      rec_type_S = 4.
    endif.

  else.
* update in view -> update in secondary table
    if langu_field is initial.
      rec_type_S = 1.
    else.
      rec_type_S = 2.
    endif.
  endif.

ENDFORM.                    " get_rectype_S


*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  GET_E071_OF_OBJECT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*  -->  p1        text
*  <--  p2        text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM GET_E071_OF_OBJECT
  using    objectname  type ob_object
           objecttype  type ob_typ
           activity    type TRACTIVITY
           recattr     type scpr_reca_tab
           values      type scpr_vals_tab
  changing error       type char1
           it_e071     type tr_objects
           tabledescrs type scpr_records.
* this form calculates the e071 table entries of a single customizing
* object and adds them to table it_e071
*
* the added entries depend on the customizing object tape as follows:
* type  | added e071k-entries
* -------------------------------------------------------------------
*   C   | first entry for viewcluster + additional entry for each
*       | view/S-table of cluster which is in the BC-Set (in recattr)
*   L   | one entry for each instance of the L-object which is in the
*       | BC-Set (in recattr)
*   S   | one entry for S-Table
*   T   | one entry for T-object
*   V   | one entry for view
* other | one TABU-like entry
*
* in case of an error 'error = X' will be returned and the system
* message fields will be filled

  statics  langkeys   TYPE standard TABLE OF t002.

  data counter            TYPE i.
  data mtext              type string.                      "#EC NEEDED
  data objnamelen         type objh-objnamelen.
  data special_symbol(1)  TYPE c.
  data tablekey           type scpr_raw.

  data fielddescr   TYPE scpr_descr.
  data keypattern   TYPE objsl.
  data tabledescr   type scpr_record2.
  data wa_e071      type e071.
  data wa_recattr   type scprreca.
  data wa_vals      type scprvals.

  data keypatterns    TYPE standard TABLE OF objsl.
  data record_values  type scpr_vals_tab.

  field-symbols  <pointer>       TYPE char1.
  field-symbols  <tabledescr>    type scpr_record2.

  CLEAR: error, wa_e071.
  wa_e071-pgmid = 'R3TR'.
  wa_e071-activity = activity.
  IF objecttype <> otype_tlogo.
* all objecttypes except 'L' just get one entry...
    wa_e071-obj_name = objectname.
    wa_e071-objfunc = 'K'.
    CASE objecttype.
      WHEN otype_view.
        wa_e071-object = mtype_view.
      WHEN otype_cluster.
        wa_e071-object = mtype_cluster.
      WHEN otype_special.
        wa_e071-object = mtype_special.
      WHEN otype_table or otype_unknown.
        wa_e071-object = mtype_table.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        error = 'X'.
        message e575 into mtext
            with objecttype 'OBJECTTYPE' 'GET_E071_OF_OBJECT'.
        return.
    ENDCASE.
    COLLECT wa_e071 INTO it_e071.
    if objecttype = otype_cluster.
* at view cluster the entries of the affected views must be added
      loop at recattr into wa_recattr where objectname = objectname
                                      and   objecttype = objecttype.
        if wa_recattr-tablename <> wa_e071-obj_name.
          wa_e071-obj_name = wa_recattr-tablename.
* get table descriptions
          if not <tabledescr> is assigned
                      or <tabledescr>-tabname <> wa_recattr-tablename.
            READ TABLE tabledescrs WITH KEY
                tabname = wa_recattr-tablename assigning <tabledescr>.
            if sy-subrc <> 0 or not <tabledescr> is assigned.
              error = 'X'.
              message e569 into mtext with wa_recattr-tablename.
              return.
            endif.
            if <tabledescr>-tabtype = otype_view.
              wa_e071-object = mtype_view.
              COLLECT wa_e071 INTO it_e071.
            elseif <tabledescr>-tabtype = otype_table.
              wa_e071-object = mtype_table.
              COLLECT wa_e071 INTO it_e071.
            else.
              error = 'X'.
              message e569 into mtext with wa_recattr-tablename.
              return.
            endif.
          endif.
        endif.
      endloop.
    endif.
  ELSE.
* fill e071 for logical transport objects
    wa_e071-object = objectname.
* get length of object
    clear objnamelen.
    SELECT SINGLE objnamelen FROM objh INTO (objnamelen)
                              WHERE objectname = objectname
                              AND   objecttype = objecttype.
    if sy-subrc <> 0 or objnamelen is initial.
      error = 'X'.
      message e777 into mtext with objectname 'OBJSL'.
      return.
    endif.
* loop at data records of logical object
    loop at recattr into wa_recattr where objectname = objectname
                                    and   objecttype = objecttype
                                    and   genref is initial.
* get table descriptions
      if not <tabledescr> is assigned
                      or <tabledescr>-tabname <> wa_recattr-tablename.
        READ TABLE tabledescrs WITH KEY
                      tabname = wa_recattr-tablename
                      tabtype = otype_special assigning <tabledescr>.
        if sy-subrc <> 0 or not <tabledescr> is assigned.
          clear tabledescr.
          tabledescr-tabname = wa_recattr-tablename.
          tabledescr-tabtype = otype_special.
          CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_DB_TABLE_TABFLDDEF_GET'
            EXPORTING
              TABNAME             = wa_recattr-tablename
            IMPORTING
              TABLEN              = tabledescr-tablen
              KEYLEN              = tabledescr-keylen
              CKEYLEN             = tabledescr-ckeylen
              CLIENT_FIELD        = tabledescr-clnt_fld
              DELIVERY_CLASS      = tabledescr-deliverycl
            TABLES
              FIELDDESCR          = tabledescr-descr
            EXCEPTIONS
              TABLE_NOT_FOUND     = 1
              DDIF_INTERNAL_ERROR = 2
              OTHERS              = 3.
          IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
            append tabledescr to tabledescrs.
            sort tabledescrs by tabname tabtype.
            READ TABLE tabledescrs WITH KEY
                       tabname = wa_recattr-tablename
                       tabtype = otype_special assigning <tabledescr>.
            if sy-subrc <> 0 or not <tabledescr> is assigned.
              error = 'X'.
              message e569 into mtext with wa_recattr-tablename.
              return.
            endif.
          else.
            error = 'X'.
            MESSAGE ID SY-MSGID TYPE SY-MSGTY NUMBER SY-MSGNO
                  into mtext WITH SY-MSGV1 SY-MSGV2 SY-MSGV3 SY-MSGV4.
            return.
          endif.
        endif.
* get key patterns
        REFRESH: keypatterns.
        SELECT * FROM objsl INTO TABLE keypatterns
          where objectname = objectname and objecttype = objecttype.
        delete keypatterns where tobj_name <> wa_recattr-tablename.
* there may remain more than one keypattern for a certain table!
        if keypatterns is initial.
          error = 'X'.
          message e777 into mtext with objectname 'OBJSL'.
          return.
        endif.
      endif.
* extract all values of record -> 'record_values'
      refresh: record_values.
      read table values with key id        = wa_recattr-id
                                 version   = wa_recattr-version
                                 tablename = wa_recattr-tablename
                                 recnumber = wa_recattr-recnumber
                               transporting no fields binary search.
      if sy-subrc = 0.
        loop at values into wa_vals from sy-tabix.
          if wa_vals-id          <> wa_recattr-id
              or wa_vals-version   <> wa_recattr-version
              or wa_vals-tablename <> wa_recattr-tablename
              or wa_vals-recnumber <> wa_recattr-recnumber.
            exit.
          else.
            append wa_vals to record_values.
          endif.
        endloop.
      endif.
      if record_values is initial.
        error = 'X'.
        message e568 into mtext with wa_recattr-id.
        return.
      endif.
* at language dependent keys...
      READ TABLE <tabledescr>-descr INTO fielddescr
                           WITH KEY datatype = 'LANG' keyflag = 'X'.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
* ... -> replace language by logon language
        READ TABLE record_values WITH KEY
                      fieldname = fielddescr-fieldname INTO wa_vals.
        wa_vals-value = sy-langu.
        MODIFY record_values INDEX sy-tabix FROM wa_vals.
* ... -> get language infos
        IF langkeys is initial.
          SELECT spras FROM t002 INTO TABLE langkeys.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
* transfer bc-set key into container
      clear tablekey.
      CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_CPROF_CT_PROFDATA_CONVERT'
        EXPORTING
          tabname    = wa_recattr-tablename
          only_key   = 'X'
          recnumber  = wa_recattr-recnumber
        IMPORTING
          raw_record = tablekey
        TABLES
          profvalues = record_values
          tabledescr = <tabledescr>-descr.
      LOOP AT keypatterns INTO keypattern.
* get the instance of the logical object out of the pattern
        CLEAR: counter, special_symbol, wa_e071-obj_name.
        DO.
          if counter >= 100.
            exit.
          else.
            ASSIGN keypattern-tobjkey+counter(1) TO <pointer>.
            IF special_symbol IS INITIAL.
              if <pointer> = '/'.
                special_symbol = 'X'.
              elseif tablekey-lines(1) = <pointer>.
                SHIFT tablekey-lines.
              ELSE.
                EXIT.
              ENDIF.
            ELSE.
              CLEAR special_symbol.
              CASE <pointer>.
                WHEN  '*'.
                  EXIT.
                WHEN 'C'.
                  SHIFT tablekey-lines BY 3 PLACES.
                WHEN '&'.
                  wa_e071-obj_name(objnamelen) = tablekey-lines.
                  exit.
                WHEN 'L'.
                 READ TABLE langkeys WITH KEY spras = tablekey-lines(1)
                                                TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
                  IF sy-subrc = 0.
                    SHIFT tablekey-lines.
                  ELSE.
                    EXIT.
                  ENDIF.
                WHEN '/'.
                  IF tablekey-lines(1) = '/'.
                    SHIFT tablekey-lines.
                  ELSE.
                    EXIT.
                  ENDIF.
                when others.
                  EXIT.
              ENDCASE.
            ENDIF.
            counter = counter + 1.
          endif.
        ENDDO.
* if the pattern fits -> keep the found object
        IF not wa_e071-obj_name is initial.
          COLLECT wa_e071 INTO it_e071.
          exit.  "one entry per keypattern is enough
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.  "keypatterns
    ENDLOOP.  "recattr
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.                    " GET_E071_OF_OBJECT

FORM get_bcset_sal
  using bcset         type scpr_id
        version       type scpr_vers
        category      type scpr_ctgry
        cli_dep       type scpr_cldep
        ignore_langu  type scpr_x
  changing  sal       type scprsald.
* this form gets the SAL of a BC-Set from DB
* at ignore_langu = 'X' SALs of language activations are ignored

  data wa_sali  type scprsali.

  data it_sali  type scpr_sali_tab.
  data it_sald  type scpr_sald_tab.


  clear: it_sald, it_sali, sal, wa_sali.
  if cli_dep = cont_cli_indep.
* client independent BC-Set
    wa_sali-bcset = bcset.
    wa_sali-version = version.
    wa_sali-category = category.
    append wa_sali to it_sali.
    CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_SFW_READ_SAL'
      EXPORTING
        IGNORE_LANGU = ignore_langu
      CHANGING
        IT_SALI      = it_sali.
    if it_sali is initial.
      clear sal.
    else.
      clear wa_sali.
      read table it_sali index 1 into wa_sali.
      if wa_sali is initial.
        clear wa_sali.
      else.
        move-corresponding wa_sali to sal.
      endif.
    endif.
  elseif cli_dep = cont_cli_dep.
* client dependent BC-Set
    sal-client = sy-mandt.
    sal-bcset = bcset.
    sal-version = version.
    sal-category = category.
    append sal to it_sald.
    CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_SFW_READ_SAL'
      EXPORTING
        IGNORE_LANGU = ignore_langu
      CHANGING
        IT_SALD      = it_sald.
    if it_sald is initial.
      clear sal.
    else.
      read table it_sald index 1 into sal.
    endif.
  else.
    clear sal.
  endif.

  METHOD show_list .
* this method displays an ALV with all activation processes of a given
* BC-Set

    data caption(70)    type c.
    data flag_acg       type scpr_x.
    data flag_langu     type scpr_x.
    data flag_moddate   type scpr_x.
    data flag_modtime   type scpr_x.
    data flag_status    type scpr_x.

    data fieldcatline   type lvc_s_fcat.
    data text_temp(10)  type c.
    data wa_outtab      type scprsacalv.

* sort outtab
    clear outtab.
    append lines of it_outtab to outtab.
    sort outtab descending by act_date act_time.

* check field catalog: columns which are empty will not be displayed
    clear: flag_acg, flag_langu, flag_moddate, flag_modtime,
           flag_status.
    loop at fieldcat into fieldcatline.
      if fieldcatline-fieldname = 'STATUS_ICON'
                             or fieldcatline-fieldname = 'MODDATE'
                             or fieldcatline-fieldname = 'MODTIME'
                             or fieldcatline-fieldname = 'LANGU_ONLY'
                             or fieldcatline-fieldname = 'ACG_MODE'.
        fieldcatline-no_out = 'X'.
        modify fieldcat from fieldcatline.
      endif.
    endloop.
    loop at outtab into wa_outtab.
      if flag_status is initial.
        if not wa_outtab-status_icon is initial.
          read table fieldcat into fieldcatline
                                  with key fieldname = 'STATUS_ICON'.
          if sy-subrc = 0.
            clear fieldcatline-no_out.
            modify fieldcat index sy-tabix from fieldcatline.
            flag_status = 'X'.
          endif.
        endif.
      endif.
      if flag_moddate is initial.
        if not wa_outtab-moddate is initial.
          read table fieldcat into fieldcatline
                                       with key fieldname = 'MODDATE'.
          if sy-subrc = 0.
            clear fieldcatline-no_out.
            modify fieldcat index sy-tabix from fieldcatline.
            flag_moddate = 'X'.
          endif.
        endif.
      endif.
      if flag_modtime is initial.
        if not wa_outtab-modtime is initial.
          read table fieldcat into fieldcatline
                                       with key fieldname = 'MODTIME'.
          if sy-subrc = 0.
            clear fieldcatline-no_out.
            modify fieldcat index sy-tabix from fieldcatline.
            flag_modtime = 'X'.
          endif.
        endif.
      endif.
      if flag_langu is initial.
        if not wa_outtab-langu_only is initial.
          read table fieldcat into fieldcatline
                                    with key fieldname = 'LANGU_ONLY'.
          if sy-subrc = 0.
            clear fieldcatline-no_out.
            modify fieldcat index sy-tabix from fieldcatline.
            flag_langu = 'X'.
          endif.
        endif.
      endif.
      if flag_acg is initial.
        if not wa_outtab-acg_mode is initial.
          read table fieldcat into fieldcatline
                                    with key fieldname = 'ACG_MODE'.
          if sy-subrc = 0.
            clear fieldcatline-no_out.
            modify fieldcat index sy-tabix from fieldcatline.
            flag_acg = 'X'.
          endif.
        endif.
      endif.
      if not flag_acg is initial and not flag_langu is initial
         and not flag_moddate is initial and not flag_modtime is initial
         and not flag_status is initial.
        exit.
      endif.
    endloop.


* display ALV
    alv_active = 'X'.
    IF dialogbox_status IS INITIAL.
      dialogbox_status = 'X' .
      caption = 'Aktivierungsvorgänge zu BC-Set'(091).
      concatenate caption bcset '(' into caption separated by space.
      concatenate caption 'vom' into caption.
      clear text_temp.
      write moddate to text_temp DD/MM/YYYY.
      concatenate caption text_temp into caption separated by space.
      concatenate caption ',' into caption.
      clear text_temp.
      write modtime to text_temp.
      concatenate caption text_temp into caption separated by space.
      concatenate caption ')' into caption.
      CREATE OBJECT dialogbox_container
        EXPORTING
          width        = 900
          height       = 150
          lifetime     = cntl_lifetime_dynpro
          top          = 150
          left         = 100
          caption      = caption.

      CREATE OBJECT alv
        exporting
          i_parent = dialogbox_container.

      SET HANDLER: handle_close FOR dialogbox_container ,
                   handle_double_click FOR alv .

      CALL METHOD alv->set_table_for_first_display
               EXPORTING
                 it_toolbar_excluding = lt_exclude
*         is_layout            = gs_layout
*         i_structure_name     = 'SFW_LOGFILE'
               CHANGING
                 it_fieldcatalog  = fieldcat
                 it_outtab        = outtab .

      CALL METHOD cl_gui_control=>set_focus
        EXPORTING
          control = alv.

    ELSE.

* set new fieldcatalog
      CALL METHOD alv->set_frontend_fieldcatalog
        EXPORTING
          it_fieldcatalog = fieldcat.

      dialogbox_container->set_visible( visible = 'X' ) .
      alv->refresh_table_display( ).

    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.                    "show_list
